description: This file defines a custom exception class `PostDatedCheckNotFoundException` for handling cases where a post-dated check is not found in the system. It extends a base exception class and provides two constructors for creating specific exception messages.

classes.name: PostDatedCheckNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a specific post-dated check could not be found, either by ID or by loan ID and installment number.

methods.name: PostDatedCheckNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating an invalid check ID.

methods.name: PostDatedCheckNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a missing check for a specific loan ID and installment number.
